about_blocks.text: Live Free Addiction Services Canada offers drug and alcohol interventions in Calgary and surrounding areas to men and women. We also work with various unions in the Calgary area to help professional people get the help they need. We help to make the intervention process as manageable as possible. Sometimes the initial call and beginning stages of the intervention can be hard for people. But our professional and highly trained staff is here to help. We have performed various interventions in Calgary over the years. We are sensitive to the needs of families and their biggest challenges/concerns regarding their loved ones. Our interventionists are highly successful and very compassionate.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
